title: Does this count as mall world?
content: I have a reoccurring dream that I’m in a large apartment with a lot of rooms. In the dream there is a room with pictures and paintings and I feel amazing in this room. The apartment seems to go on forever and sometimes I will explore the different rooms however sometimes the room is blocked off because it’s haunted and I cant go in there. When this happens I keep trying to get into those rooms to see for myself if it is haunted. I have this same type of dream maybe twice a week and I always feel good when waking up.
